steps.lean: set Q := ball Z _
steps.claim: Let Q be the ball of radius P⁻⁶/2 about Z.

steps.lean:

steps.lean: let ψ := List.foldr (fun ((a, b), c, d) ψ y ↦ ψ y * (y⁻¹.1 a d * y.1 c b / P ^ 40)) φ
steps.claim: For a word w of index pairs ((a, b), (c, d)), ψ_w(y) = φ(y)·∏ (y⁻¹)_{ad}·y_{cb}/P⁴⁰ over the letters of w.

steps.lean:

steps.claim: Each ψ_w is measurable and |ψ_w(y)| ≤ |φ(y)|: where φ(y) ≠ 0, ‖y‖ ≤ P²⁰ (hφ'), so each factor has absolute value ≤ ‖y⁻¹‖‖y‖/P⁴⁰ = ‖y‖²/P⁴⁰ ≤ 1.

steps.lean: have iψ i := hi.mono (by fun_prop) (.of_forall (hψ i)); choose V v hW hd hs using hV
steps.claim: Each ψ_w is integrable; unpack hV: Bessel functions V_w with V_[] = F_𝔰 (v), each a Bessel function (hW), with the derivative rule along one-parameter families (hd) and Schur bounds (hs).

steps.lean: let T i g y := ψ i y • V (i.map (·.1)) (g * y)
steps.claim: Let T_w(g, y) = ψ_w(y)·V_{w₁}(gy), w₁ the word of first components of w.

steps.lean:

This leaves the derivative bound (14), the cube bound (15) and the arithmetic (16).
